propositions: A new advisory plan-review criterion must require plans that add/alter failure/timeout/exception/retry/fallback semantics to state their failure-disposition contract (retryable vs fatal per affected arm).

The criterion must detect and FAIL plans that add fallback arms without stating which disposition wins when the fallback itself fails, preventing retryable primary paths from being masked by non-retryable fallback failures (the 1c0d root cause).

The criterion is registered as project.failure-disposition-contract with exec:1-TURN, advisory posture, container+leaf scope, and must not suppress bug tickets so it fires on escalated bugs with non-test file_impact like the origin 8fbd config flip.

Pass condition requires per-affected-arm explicit disposition words (retryable/transient vs fatal/permanent) and, when fallback chains exist, a statement that the most-recoverable leg's disposition is preserved.
